feedback: Iteration 1 (entityR2B) supports the span change: line_loss fell from 1 to 0 on oval and s-bend, and to 0.1 on slalom, so the 0.06 m span is working and should be kept. The remaining failure is tracking, not sensing: max_error stayed at 0.062 to 0.064 m and every run still went off_track, with rms_error steady at 0.026 to 0.029 m. Steering oscillation is low (0.13 to 0.27), so the controller is not jittering and has room to tighten. Your planned lag and inertia change (sensor y 0.03 to 0.02, body_length 0.14, mass 0.7) addresses the late-reaction evidence in slalom progress (0.10). I am adjusting the controller to match, and I am not asking for further geometry changes yet, so the next race can show whether the lag change alone is enough. If max_error stays at about 0.062 m after this race, the limit is the controller and the speed on bends, not geometry, so please hold the geometry rather than change it again. If slalom progress rises above 0.1 but max_error still fails, a shorter wheel_track gives more turn rate per unit of wheel differential (turn rate = difference / track), which is the next geometry lever to test. The Builder's idea of a 7-sensor array is not supported by the evidence yet, because line loss is already near zero.
requested_changes: Keep the sensor span at x = -0.06 to +0.06 with 16 mm footprints, and keep sensor y = 0.02 and the reduced mass and body_length as proposed, so this race tests the lag and inertia change on its own.
If max_error stays at about 0.062 m and slalom progress is still at or below 0.10, try wheel_track 0.10 to increase turn authority per unit of wheel differential.
Do not add sensors (no 7-sensor array) unless line_loss_events rises above 0.1 on any development track.
